# TECH360

> TECH360 LLC builds enterprise websites, eCommerce platforms, custom CRMs, AI-assisted applications, and business automation. Project scope, payment, delivery, and support are agreed in writing. TECH360 LLC is registered in Harrisonville, Missouri, USA. All money amounts on this site are in USD.

TECH360 (domain: bdtech360.com) — Strategy. Software. Automation. Growth. Public enquiries: [info@bdtech360.com](mailto:info@bdtech360.com), +1 (816) 380-8660.
